title: Daemon restart does not re-adopt live fleetd harness sessions: tasks are marked failed and resume refuses on the live supervision key
wanted_capability: When blackboxd restarts while fleetd-supervised harness children are running, the daemon should re-adopt each live session on startup: restore the task record as running, reattach to the fleetd event stream (replay from the durable event log), and let bro_status, bro_wait, bro_when_all, and bro_resume work against it. Observed 2026-09-20: two glm dispatches survived two daemon restarts (fleetd kept the harness children alive and they continued editing and committing), but the daemon reported both tasks as failed with "server restarted while task was running ... retry with bro_resume", and every bro_resume then failed at harness setup with "fleetd session id ... is genuinely live (fleetd reports a running worker under this supervision key); refusing to multiplex two dispatches onto one supervision key". The only way to observe the work was the on-disk events.jsonl and the lane git branches; the final assistant result and bro_report milestones are not captured in the task store. The process isolation delivered survival; the task plane lost the handle.
missing_primitive: startup re-adoption of live fleetd supervision keys into the daemon task store (or a bro_adopt verb), and a bro_resume path that attaches to a live session instead of refusing
fallback_used: Watched the lane branches and the on-disk event logs with a shell loop instead of the task plane.
evidence: bro_when_all result 2026-09-20T05:0x UTC: status failed, recoverable true, stderr 'server restarted while task was running'
bro_resume tasks a3f899a7 and 1f44af36: 'harness child setup failed: fleetd session id is genuinely live ... refusing to multiplex'
~/.local/state/blackbox/bro/harness-sessions/<session>.events.jsonl still growing after the restarts; lane branches receiving commits
bbox-cage README acceptance list names 'blackboxd restart re-adoption'
